summary.text: Pedro Soares de Souza is an independent candidate on the November 3, 2026 ballot for Rhode Island's 1st District; his campaign website presents his name as Pedro DeSouza. The site describes him as someone who has worked in restaurants, built a small business and moved into a data career after COVID, and lists affordability, housing, single-payer health care and ending foreign wars among his positions.

sources.title: United States House of Representatives elections in Rhode Island, 2026
